lines: Did you hear? The river was extra sparkly this morning.
I've been practising my whistling. Want to hear? Maybe later.
If you find a shiny rock, tell me first, okay?
Rain, rain, rain! The puddles are perfect for stomping.
The sky goes all orange this time of day. I love it.
Ooh, it's you! Today is going to be amazing, I can tell!
I did ten twirls in a row this morning. Ten!
I had a snack, then a nap, then another snack. Busy day.
Hmph. You again. Well, I suppose that's fine.
Back in my day, the trees were taller.
Cold enough to freeze a fish. Don't stand there, it's cold.
Bob here! I've been thinking about lunch all day.
